name: Vuln-Inc
subtitle: Official vdpi releases for iOS
description: Zero-hassle, self-healing anti-DPI engine in Rust. Runs 100% on-device with zero remote servers or telemetry.

apps.name: vdpi
apps.subtitle: On-device anti-DPI engine in Rust
apps.localizedDescription: Zero-hassle, self-healing anti-DPI engine running 100% locally via NEPacketTunnelProvider. Supports 7-stage adaptive TLS desync, encrypted DNS-over-HTTPS, QUIC blocking, persistent adaptive stage caching, Siri Shortcuts, and zero external VPN servers.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Overhauled iOS NEPacketTunnelProvider with direct utun fd I/O + batched packetFlow fallback and 4064 MTU
- Fixed false IPv6 detection on IPv4-only Wi-Fi and fc00::/7 IPv6 DNS self-exclusion
- Added excludeLocalNetworks, excludeAPNs, excludeCellularServices, and CGNAT exclusions (fixing LAN and home camera apps)
- Enabled QUIC ICMP Port Unreachable, 64-session Jetsam-safe smoltcp runner, FIN_WAIT_2 leak fix, 2x DoH failover cap, and DirectPassthrough + TLS 1.3 0-RTT auto-heal
- Added Sideloadly-proof providerConfiguration/options settings delivery, defaultPath KVO + route-change rebinding, and fetchLastDisconnectError UI surfacing
- Aligned mobile releases with v0.5.1 (desktop auto-sudo/UAC elevation for TUN switching and macOS LaunchDaemon reliability fixes)

- Shared vdpi-core engine and zero-lag UDP bypass (smoltcp UDP removed, STUN/TURN UDP/443 pass-through)
- Hardened Turkish ISP anti-DPI (Superonline/TTNet/Kablonet/Vodafone TR), webpki-roots verified bound DoH, and expanded bank/payment/Riot/CIDR bypass defaults
- Fixed iOS live-reload disconnect race, overlapping reload IPCs, CIDR bypass normalization, and Jetsam thread pool bounds
Desktop Control Center release with live service/DPI status, temporary pause/resume, and inline-confirmed uninstall.

- Dynamic iOS App Group and PacketTunnel extension bundle ID auto-detection for paid Apple Developer / Sideloadly / Feather re-signing
- Persistent adaptive stage cache, Activity sparkline, quiet GitHub update checker, and Siri Shortcuts

- Persistent adaptive stage cache in App Group container
- Activity throughput sparkline and smooth numeric counters
- Quiet GitHub Releases update checker
- Siri Shortcuts and iOS Automations (AppIntents)
- Settings JSON backup/restore and 1-tap shareable diagnostics
